title: An activation changes the shape
summary: An activation applies a chosen rule after a weighted sum. ReLU keeps positive numbers and changes negative numbers to zero.
introduction: An activation applies a chosen rule after a weighted sum. ReLU keeps positive numbers and changes negative numbers to zero. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.

blocks.title: An activation changes the shape

blocks.text: The output is [0, 0, 3]. max picks the larger of zero and the input. This bend helps networks model more varied patterns.
